rules: Required layers are fixed by the canonical matrix in report/phase1/tests/test_editorial_register.py (Hindi language: 1, 3, 7, 8-18, C1-C4, C6; Jyotish: 1-7, C5; owner copy: 13, 15). A required layer is PENDING, ACCEPTED, REVISED or REJECTED, never NOT_APPLICABLE; every other layer is NOT_APPLICABLE.

KUN-GOV-SIMPLE-001 (issue #75): no signed sheet, attestation form, signature, qualification statement or evidence-ingest commit is required. A decided owner_copy layer records the owner's decision as made in chat and recorded in GitHub: decided_by (a named human, never an AI), source, record (the GitHub issue, PR or comment URL in this repository), decision_date, decision_text, the exact reviewed_commit and both catalog SHA-256 values; recorded_by may name whoever transcribed it. A decided human_hindi_language or human_jyotish_terminology layer records a named human reviewer (never an AI, never the owner's copy decision), decision_date, the exact reviewed_commit and catalog SHA-256 values, and the GitHub record (for example the reviewer's issue or PR comment).

AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT or any other) never decide a human or owner layer or the release; they may record a decision someone else made, naming it in recorded_by. Developer corrections and AI QA are recorded only in their own layers.
A decision is valid only for the catalog bytes it names; any later catalog change makes it stale until the decider re-confirms.

customer_release is PENDING or APPROVED. APPROVED requires every required layer of every item ACCEPTED (REVISED and REJECTED are never approvals) and a separate, explicit owner release directive recorded in GitHub (approved_by, source, record, date, decision_text); an owner copy decision is never a release.

Exact git identity, not SHA format: every decision's reviewed_commit equals reviewed_source.commit; reviewed_source commit, tree and catalog blob IDs are checked against the git object database (blob IDs alone in a git archive, where an approved release is refused as unverifiable); an approved release names an explicit release_candidate {commit, tree, catalog hashes and blobs} that exists in git, contains the reviewed source and carries the reviewed catalogs, and customer_release.commit equals it.
